## TC-001-P :: "Next" Control Visible on Page 1
- **Type**: Positive
- **Priority**: High
- **Preconditions**: Network access to http://books.toscrape.com
- **Test Data**: URL = `/` (page 1)
- **Steps**: 1. Navigate to `/` 2. Assert `li.next > a` is visible 3. Assert its `href` attribute is non-empty
- **Expected Result**: "next" control is visible with a valid, non-empty `href`
- **Linked FR**: FR-01
- **Fault Type**: n/a

## TC-002-P :: "Next" Control Still Visible on Page 49 (Boundary)
- **Type**: Boundary
- **Priority**: Medium
- **Preconditions**: Network access to `/catalogue/page-49.html`
- **Test Data**: URL = `/catalogue/page-49.html`
- **Steps**: 1. Navigate directly to page 49 2. Assert `li.next > a` is visible
- **Expected Result**: "next" control is still visible one page before the boundary where it disappears
- **Linked FR**: FR-01
- **Fault Type**: n/a

## TC-003-F :: "Next" Control Not Falsely Hidden on a Valid Page
- **Type**: Negative
- **Priority**: Medium
- **Preconditions**: Page 1 loaded
- **Test Data**: `li.next` computed style
- **Steps**: 1. Navigate to page 1 2. Assert `li.next` is present in the DOM 3. Assert its nested `a` link is visible (not `display:none` / `visibility:hidden`)
- **Expected Result**: The control is not present-but-invisible; a visitor can actually see and use it
- **Linked FR**: FR-01
- **Fault Type**: state

## TC-005-F :: Clicking "Next" Does Not Leave URL Unchanged
- **Type**: Negative
- **Priority**: High
- **Preconditions**: Homepage loaded
- **Test Data**: URL before and after click
- **Steps**: 1. Record URL on page 1 2. Click `li.next > a` 3. Compare pre- and post-click URLs
- **Expected Result**: Post-click URL differs from pre-click URL and contains `page-2`

## TC-006-F :: Rapid Double-Click on "Next" Does Not Skip to Page 3
- **Type**: Boundary
- **Priority**: Low
- **Preconditions**: Homepage loaded
- **Test Data**: Two synchronous click events dispatched on `li.next > a`
- **Steps**: 1. Navigate to page 1 2. Dispatch two click events on `li.next > a` in the same tick 3. Assert final URL does not contain `page-3`
- **Expected Result**: A single logical navigation occurs (settling on page 1 or page 2); the duplicate click never causes an unexpected skip to page 3
- **Linked FR**: FR-02
- **Fault Type**: navigation

## TC-007-P :: New Book Set Displayed After Navigating to Page 2
- **Type**: Positive
- **Priority**: High
- **Preconditions**: Page 1 loaded; titles collected
- **Test Data**: All 20 page-1 book titles (`title` attribute)
- **Steps**: 1. Navigate to page 1; collect all `article.product_pod h3 > a` `title` attributes 2. Click `li.next > a` 3. Collect page-2 titles 4. Assert no title from page 1 appears in the page-2 set
- **Expected Result**: Page 2 shows a completely distinct set of books from page 1
- **Linked FR**: FR-03
- **Fault Type**: n/a

## TC-008-F :: Page 2 Is Not a Duplicate or Empty Render of Page 1
- **Type**: Negative
- **Priority**: High
- **Preconditions**: Page 1 loaded
- **Test Data**: Page 1 and page 2 title arrays
- **Steps**: 1. Collect page 1 titles 2. Navigate via "next" to page 2 3. Assert page 2 title array is non-empty and not identical to page 1's
- **Expected Result**: Page 2 renders its own distinct, non-empty book set
- **Linked FR**: FR-03
- **Fault Type**: state

## TC-009-P :: Page 2 Book Count Is Within Expected Bounds
- **Type**: Boundary
- **Priority**: Medium
- **Preconditions**: Navigated to page 2
- **Test Data**: Count of `article.product_pod` on page 2
- **Steps**: 1. Navigate via "next" to page 2 2. Count `article.product_pod` elements 3. Assert count is between 1 and 20 inclusive
- **Expected Result**: Page 2 contains at least 1 and at most 20 book items
- **Linked FR**: FR-03
- **Fault Type**: n/a

## TC-010-P :: Clicking "Next" Twice Advances Page 1 → 2 → 3
- **Type**: Positive
- **Priority**: High
- **Preconditions**: Homepage loaded
- **Test Data**: None
- **Steps**: 1. Navigate to page 1 2. Click `li.next > a`; assert URL contains `page-2` 3. Click `li.next > a` again; assert URL contains `page-3` 4. Collect titles on page 3; assert no overlap with page 2's titles
- **Expected Result**: Sequential navigation reaches page 3 with a further distinct book set

## TC-011-F :: Repeated Navigation Does Not Repeat a Previously Seen Page
- **Type**: Negative
- **Priority**: Medium
- **Preconditions**: Homepage loaded
- **Test Data**: URLs visited across 3 consecutive "next" clicks
- **Steps**: 1. Navigate to page 1 2. Click "next" three times, recording the URL after each click 3. Assert the three recorded URLs are all distinct (`page-2`, `page-3`, `page-4`)
- **Expected Result**: No page URL is visited twice during sequential forward navigation
- **Linked FR**: FR-04
- **Fault Type**: navigation

## TC-022-P :: Browser Back Returns to Page 1 After Using "Next"
- **Type**: Positive
- **Priority**: High
- **Preconditions**: Navigated from page 1 to page 2 via "next"
- **Test Data**: Page 1 titles recorded before navigating forward
- **Steps**: 1. Navigate to page 1; record titles 2. Click `li.next > a`; confirm URL contains `page-2` 3. Trigger browser back navigation 4. Assert URL no longer contains `page-2` 5. Assert `article.product_pod` titles match the originally recorded page 1 set
- **Expected Result**: Back navigation fully restores page 1's URL and content
- **Linked FR**: FR-08
- **Fault Type**: n/a

## TC-023-F :: "Next" Control Is Available Again After Navigating Back
- **Type**: Negative
- **Priority**: Medium
- **Preconditions**: Completed forward-then-back navigation (page 1 → 2 → back to 1)
- **Test Data**: `li.next > a` state after back navigation
- **Steps**: 1. Perform page 1 → "next" → page 2 → browser back 2. Assert `li.next > a` is present and visible again
- **Expected Result**: The "next" control is not left missing or stale after returning via back navigation
- **Linked FR**: FR-08
- **Fault Type**: state

## TC-024-P :: Back Then Forward Restores Page 2 State
- **Type**: Boundary
- **Priority**: Low
- **Preconditions**: Navigated page 1 → 2 → back to page 1
- **Test Data**: Page 2 titles recorded before going back
- **Steps**: 1. Navigate page 1 → "next" → page 2; record page 2 titles 2. Trigger browser back (returns to page 1) 3. Trigger browser forward 4. Assert URL contains `page-2` again and titles match the originally recorded page 2 set
- **Expected Result**: Forward navigation after back correctly restores page 2, completing the round trip
- **Linked FR**: FR-08
- **Fault Type**: n/a
